summary: This plant coats labels and paper. It released about 24,000 lb of vinyl acetate into the air in 2024.

impacts.title: Air & breathing
impacts.how: Vinyl acetate is a vapor from the adhesives and coatings used here. It irritates the eyes, nose and throat.

avoid.label: Report odors
avoid.text: Report strong or unusual odors in the forum, where the company can reply. You can also call the DNR tip line, 1-800-847-9367

avoid.label: Close the windows
avoid.text: Keep windows closed when the smell is noticeable

avoid.label: Check air quality
avoid.text: Check the daily air quality index (AirNow), especially on hot, still days

impacts.title: Long-term health
impacts.how: The International Agency for Research on Cancer lists vinyl acetate as possibly carcinogenic to humans. The risk depends on how much people breathe in over many years.

avoid.label: Look up the records
avoid.text: Look up the plant's yearly releases in EPA's Toxics Release Inventory

avoid.label: Comment on permits
avoid.text: Comment on the plant's air permit when the DNR opens it for public input

avoid.label: Ask the plant
avoid.text: Ask the plant about plans to cut vapor emissions
